test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: In the following sentence, an idiom is highlighted. Select the alternative which best describes its use in the sentence.**

Mr. Raghav __racked his brain__, but couldn't think where he had left the book.

options.text: had a series of consecutive thoughts
knew it, but couldn't quite remember it
thought he had heard something before

solution:
The correct answer is** thought very hard**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rack one's brain: **make a great effort to think of or remember something. (किसी चीज के बारे में सोचने या याद रखने का भरपूर प्रयास करना)

 
 
• **Example:** I've been ***racking my brains*__** all day but I can't remember her name.
 
 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is **option 1**. 

190:T903,

The correct answer is** familiar**.
